description.html: The artificial plant with base is a low, dense, light green plant on a dark base that keeps it upright. You can place it anywhere in the aquarium and move it whenever you like, without burying it in the substrate.

Unlike live plants, an artificial one needs no lighting, fertilizer or trimming and does not change water quality. Even fish that usually destroy plants cannot eat it, and the dense leaves give cover to smaller fish and fry.

Its low, bushy shape suits the front of the aquarium or filling space around larger decorations. The light green color stands out nicely on a dark substrate, and the dense leaves give cover to smaller fish. Maintenance is simple: every few weeks, or when you notice algae, rinse the plant with lukewarm water and go over it with a soft brush. Do not use detergents or cleaning products.
